material: Buddy Talks AUDIO FILE - the /s/ at the start
lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll delete the vowel that Portuguese inserts at the start of a word. It’s the... …GHOST E! Portuguese never starts with S + consonant: storm

So our mouth solves the problem by adding a vowel that English never had. The extra syllable is the single most recognisable Brazilian accent marker.
